basic_details.job_title: NAM DPMSU Yoga Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The District Programme Management & Supporting Unit (DPMSU) of National AYUSH Mission, Kollam, is recruiting Yoga Instructors on contract basis under various AYUSH institutions in Kollam District, at a monthly consolidated remuneration of 14000/-. Applicants must hold one of the yoga-related qualifications listed in the notice and be not more than 50 years old as on 12-11-2026. Applications are submitted online at careers.nam.kerala.gov.in, and the last date is 21 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Applicants who meet the eligibility criteria must submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in. The last date for submission of online applications is 21/11/2026. The notice asks candidates to mention the details clearly in the application, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Original documents, to be produced at the time of interview
important_instructions: The recruitment is on contract basis. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Candidature will be rejected if the application details do not match the original documents produced at the interview.

content_sections.heading: About NAM DPMSU Kollam
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Programme Management & Supporting Unit of National AYUSH Mission, Kollam. The unit is recruiting a Yoga Instructor on contract basis for various AYUSH institutions in Kollam District. Its letterhead gives the phone number 0474-2082261 and the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For Yoga Instructor, the notice accepts any one of the following qualifications: BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences) BAMS MSc (Yoga) MPhil (Yoga) Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (minimum one year duration) from a recognized University Approved Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) from a recognized University or Government Department/YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Certificate, Yoga Teacher Training Course of at least one year's duration from the State Resource Centre (SRC) Diploma in Yogic Science & Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) Age limit: not exceeding 50 years as on 12-11-2026. A person born on or after 12-11-1976 can apply. The notice prints no age relaxation. For the exact wording of the qualifications, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM DPMSU Yoga Instructor
content_sections.text: Applicants who meet the eligibility criteria must submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in . The last date for submission of online applications is 21/11/2026. The notice asks candidates to mention the details clearly in the application, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Documents named in the notice: Original documents, to be produced at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection procedure includes Skill Test/Written Test and Interview, as the case may be. The notice gives no dates or venue for these stages. If the particulars in the application form do not tally with the original documents produced at the interview, the candidature will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The recruitment is on contract basis. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Candidature will be rejected if the application details do not match the original documents produced at the interview.

faq.answer: The notice prints the number of vacancies as "Anticipatory" and gives no figure.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NAM Kollam Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Yoga Instructor at NAM DPMSU?
faq.answer: BNYS, BAMS, MSc (Yoga), MPhil (Yoga), a Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga of at least one year, or one of the other yoga certificate or diploma courses listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NAM Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 50 years as on 12-11-2026. Persons born on or after 12-11-1976 can apply.
